items.t: Said his bill would treat a U.S. Senate vacancy like a congressional or legislative vacancy in Kentucky by holding a special election.
items.q: Rudy has said his bill would treat a Senate vacancy like that of a vacancy for a congressional or legislative seat in Kentucky — by holding a special election to fill the seat.

items.t: Said he has talked about changing how a Senate vacancy is filled for more than a decade, since the Blagojevich conviction.
items.q: Rudy has said he's talked about changing the way a Senate vacancy is filled for more than a decade, since the conviction of former Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich for crimes that included seeking to sell an appointment to Barack Obama’s old Senate seat.

items.t: Said he thinks his version of the bill was better and that it has nothing to do with Sen. McConnell but deals with vacancies.
items.q: I still think mine was a better version and that’s why I filed it again this year," Rudy said last week. "It has nothing to do with Sen. McConnell. It just deals with vacancies.

record.t: Filed a bill in 2021 calling for a special election to fill a Senate vacancy.
record.q: Rudy filed a bill calling for a special election to fill a Senate vacancy in 2021, but Republicans instead opted to go with the other measure limiting a governor to choose from a three-name list.

Since taking office, Rudy has had many legislative accomplishments, including authoring the 2018 state budget which, for the first time in almost two decades, fully funded public pensions and also increased per pupil public education spending to record levels.

record.t: Was elected to the Kentucky House of Representatives in 2004.
record.q: Representative Steven Rudy represents the 1 st House District, which is comprised of Ballard, Carlisle, Fulton, and Hickman counties as well as a portion of McCracken County. Elected to the House of Representatives in 2004.

record.t: Was chosen by colleagues in the House Majority Caucus to serve as House Majority Floor Leader.
record.q: Rudy was chosen by colleagues in the House Majority Caucus to serve as House Majority Floor Leader, a key role in determining legislation considered by the House.

record.t: Chaired the House Appropriations and Revenue Committee.
record.q: Previously, Rudy chaired the House Appropriations and Revenue Committee, which plays an instrumental role in the creation of the state budget as well as state and local tax policy.
He likewise sponsored comprehensive tax reform legislation, which increased Kentucky’s national tax competitiveness ranking from 33 rd to 23 rd in its first year of implementation.

record.t: Led HB 622, a bill to fill a U.S. Senate vacancy by special election.
record.q: The legislation is being led by state House GOP Leader Steven Rudy, who denies the effort is a response to McConnell stepping down from leadership.

record.t: Introduced a bill on Feb. 21 to fill a U.S. Senate vacancy by special election, and it cleared a House committee.
record.q: Rudy introduced the bill on Feb. 21 and it cleared a House committee a day after McConnell's announcement in Washington .
